task_definition.task_description: Please look up Alice’s contact info, then check her calendar availability starting June 1, 2025. After that, schedule a medium-priority meeting called “Q2 Planning” from 9:00 to 10:00 with Alice and Bob, include the description “Quarterly budget review,” then use the reminder confirmation message to create a document titled “Q2 Planning” with that message as the content and tag it with finance and travel.
